[EN] We meet again, .

The wall between worlds is threatened again.

An Underworld Nightmare is attacking the wall even as we speak. You must stop them.

The Underworld Nightmare's power should help restore the wall.
[ES] Nos volvemos a encontrar, .

La pared entre los mundos está amenazada otra vez.

Un Underworld Nightmare está atacando la pared incluso mientras hablamos. Debes detenerlos.

El poder de Underworld Nightmare debería ayudar a restaurar la pared.

[EN] I can feel the wall strengthening.

I thank you for your help.
[ES] Puedo sentir que la pared se fortalece.

Te agradezco tu ayuda.

[EN] If the wall breaks down, both your world and this one are doomed.
[ES] Si la pared se derriba, tanto tu mundo como este están condenados.
